properties.NAME: MACKINAC
properties.CHANGE: Circa 1850, MICHILIMACKINAC was renamed MACKINAC; this change was never officially adopted by the legislature and both names were used interchangeably through the 1840s.
properties.CITATION: (Mich. Acts 1847, ann. sess., no. 56/pp. 68-69; Mich. Acts 1848, ann. sess., no. 108/pp. 119-124)
